# Funky's BurnQuest — LLM / agent entrypoint

Frogger-style arcade game with a token-burn campaign wrapper.
Vanilla JS, no build step, Three.js r0.160 UMD self-hosted.

## Read first
- `AGENTS.md` — full agent guide (structure, grid, stages, traps, gates)
- `README.md` — human quick start

## Do
- Small, reviewable patches. Owner is Mimi.
- Prefer editing `sim.js` / `render3d.js` / `game.js` / `style.css` / `index.html`.
- Run headless gates before claiming a fix: `node tools/sim-contract-test.js`
- Serve locally with `python3 -m http.server 8099` (no bundler).

## Do not
- Do not deploy unless the human gives an explicit host and asks.
- Do not deploy to `ksto.world` (Mimi's production Hostinger site).
- Do not rewrite the renderer or swap Three.js versions.
- Do not normalize line endings repo-wide (mixed CRLF/LF by design).
- Do not regenerate Meshy/Blender assets unless asked (`tools/` pipeline).
- Do not commit `test-shots/`, `node_modules/`, zips, or `.versions/`.

## Live test (not production)
https://funkyburnquest.project-testing.xyz/

## Branch
Default working branch: `v1.2`
